highlights.title: Pick who reviews code
highlights.text: Settings > General > Code review now lists who reviews a thread's code changes, in order, each with its own model and effort. Drag them to change the order, or take one off. When one runs out, the next takes over.

media.alt: The Code review section of Settings with its switch on and two reviewers listed in order: Codex on GPT-6.1-Sol at High effort, then Claude on its default model at Extra high, each with a drag handle and a button to take it off.

added: Grok logins can run threads now, code reviews included, and every action Grok takes asks you first
changed: A new version of the runner's own app now takes over the next time you log in, rather than waiting for a moment when no thread is busy, which on a busy Mac never came
Switching to the new app checks there's enough disk space before it starts, and says the first build takes 20 to 40 minutes
Pictures in replies on the iPhone, Android and the website only load when they're pictures the thread itself stored; any other web picture shows as a link you can tap
fixed: Pairing your phone uses a code that works once, for ten minutes, instead of putting a long-lived token in the QR code where another app could catch it
Sandboxed threads no longer see the runner's own keys and logins
When the new app checks a file before opening it, it now opens that exact file with the app it checked, so a file swapped in between can't launch something else
A long question in an answer bubble wraps inside the bubble instead of running off its edge
A scheduled reminder no longer holds up messages waiting for a thread
A done card from another Mac's thread no longer loses its loose ends when this Mac's own thread list comes in
